content.comment_body: How can I invert the analog output so that when the analog input increases, the output decreases? For example, with a 0-10V input, I want the output to be 10V when the input is 0V, and 0V when the input is 10V.
The simplest solution is to use an analog amplifier. Please refer to the attached file for the recommended settings.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to create a reversed analog signal mapping, where a rising analog input results in a falling analog output. The discussion reveals that although this can be achieved, it is not an out-of-the-box function and typically requires configuring an analog amplifier instead of direct software changes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to find an easy, software-only solution to invert analog input and output relationships within the [product_name] system, without needing extra hardware.
